tg_p3.cite: Gardner temperature of the fully connected Ising p-spin, p = 3, couplings of variance p!/(2 N^(p-1)) (J = 1), zero field: Rizzo, Phys. Rev. E 88, 032135 (2013), doi:10.1103/PhysRevE.88.032135, arXiv:1305.2070 (PDF read), Sec. V, Eq. (27) (convention) and Fig. 1 caption and text: 'the Gardner temperature TG = 0.24026', defined as the crossing of the marginal line m_G(T) (1RSB replicon zero, after Gardner) with the static line m_s(T). Consistent (rounded) value: Yeo & Moore, Phys. Rev. E 101, 032127 (2020), doi:10.1103/PhysRevE.101.032127, arXiv:1911.02719 (PDF read), Sec. II A after Eq. (17): 'T > TG, where TG ~ 0.24 for p = 3'. Original: Gardner, Nucl. Phys. B 257 [FS14], 747 (1985) (paywalled, not fetched). Montanari & Ricci-Tersenghi, EPJB 33, 339 (2003), arXiv:cond-mat/0301591 (PDF read) show T_G only on the axis of their Fig. 2 (no digits). tol = half a unit in Rizzo's last digit
tg_p3.independent_route: replicant's own static 1RSB (families/ising_pspin.py: q equation MRT Eq. (2.3), m equation Yeo-Moore Eq. (16), float64 Gauss-Legendre) and the 1RSB replicon rule (families/gardner.py: MRT Eq. (2.6), checked against the explicit integer-n functional by finite differences and spin enumeration); T_G = zero of the static-line replicon by an 18-point scan plus brentq: 0.2402600 (build). The sign scan in tests/test_gardner_transition.py does not root-find

ts_p3.independent_route: replicant's own m = 1 condition on the larger-q branch (brentq in T of the m equation at m = 1): 0.65138523 (build); does not use the banked digits

td_p3.cite: Dynamic transition (the m = 1 1RSB solution appears; marginal and spinodal lines cross at m = 1), p = 3: Rizzo, PRE 88, 032135 (2013), arXiv:1305.2070, Fig. 1 caption and Sec. V: 'Td = .681598'. tol = half a unit in the last stated digit
td_p3.independent_route: replicant's own fold of the m = 1 q equation (brentq in beta on max_q [E_1 tanh^2 - q] = 0, families/ising_pspin.py); the m = 1 replicon vanishing there is checked separately in tests/test_gardner_transition.py
